Blood On The Heavy Metal Chess Board — Privacy Notice

Last updated: 28-07-2026

This privacy notice explains how Blood On The Heavy Metal Chess Board (“the game”) handles data. The game is developed and published by Florin Lica.

Summary

The game respects your privacy. It does not collect personal information by default. Progress and settings are stored locally on your device. Anonymous diagnostics may be sent only if you explicitly opt in. Rewarded ads may be shown using Google AdMob, which may collect anonymous device and usage data required to serve ads.

What the game may collect

  • Local data: gameplay progress, statistics, and settings are stored on your device (localStorage). This data never leaves your device unless you manually share or export it.
  • Ads: the game may display rewarded ads via Google AdMob. Ad networks may collect anonymous device and usage data required to serve ads. Personalized ads can be disabled by declining consent if a consent prompt is shown.
  • Optional diagnostics: if you opt in, the game may send anonymous crash reports or performance metrics (no names, no contact info, no identifiers).

Third parties

The game may use third‑party services to display ads or provide diagnostics. These services operate under their own privacy policies. Examples include:

  • Google AdMob — rewarded ads and anonymous ad-related diagnostics.
  • Crash/diagnostic providers (if enabled) — anonymous error reports and event counts.

No personal information is shared with third parties unless you explicitly choose to send it (for example, by emailing support).

Your choices

  • Decline diagnostics: you can choose not to enable anonymous diagnostics. If declined, no telemetry is uploaded.
  • Ad personalization: you may be able to disable personalized ads in the consent dialog. Non‑personalized ads may still be shown.
  • Delete data: all progress and settings are stored locally. You can delete them using the in‑game “Delete All Data” option or by clearing the app’s storage.

Data retention

Anonymous diagnostics (if enabled) are retained only as long as needed to analyze and fix issues. Retention depends on the service provider’s defaults.

Contact

For privacy questions or requests, contact: florinlicaetgbusiness@gmail.com

This privacy notice applies to Blood On The Heavy Metal Chess Board. Hosted at florin-lica.com.
